function.name: knowledge_search
function.description: Search approved business Knowledge available to the current user, organization, and employee. Use before answering organization-specific questions or planning actions that depend on company facts.

query.description: A focused natural-language question about the business information needed.

function.name: memory_search
function.description: Search confirmed Memory belonging to the current employee. Use for durable context and prior confirmed experience, never as a replacement for approved business Knowledge.

query.description: A focused query for relevant employee Memory.

function.name: employee_get
function.description: Read the current employee profile, ownership, organization scope, status, and configuration before proposing or applying a change.

employeeId.description: The employee identifier supplied by the authorized runtime context.

function.name: employee_skills_list
function.description: List the skills assigned to an employee, including status and enabled state, so Jaafar can reuse capabilities and avoid duplicates.

employeeId.description: The employee identifier supplied by the authorized runtime context.

function.name: integration_status
function.description: Check whether an integration or communication channel is available. This tool never performs OAuth and never exposes credentials.

integration.description: The business integration or channel to check.

function.name: human_approval
function.description: Request explicit human approval for a proposed action. This tool never performs the action itself.
